assumptions.Execution: Signal at closed 5m close with adverse cost scenario; SL-first for ambiguous bars; open positions marked, never forcibly labelled closed.
assumptions.Funding: Configured fixed-rate scenario, not historical funding. No historical bid/ask, liquidation, queue, or market-impact model.
assumptions.Splits: 60/20/20 chronological after 10-day warmup, fresh state each split; no optimization. Single-symbol accounts, not a portfolio backtest.
